metadata.title: V3 extraction relational data dictionary
metadata.status: v3.1 (amendment PRE-004, 01_protocol/amendments.json): row units, controlled vocabularies, denominators, time-bin boundary rules, background charting depth and figure-only handling revised after the 10-report AI-assisted charting pilot (accepted as calibration by A, 2026-10-05); no formal records extracted
metadata.field_count_note: The 61 legacy source fields are retained and mapped (no legacy table or column renamed); the operational schema adds relational, donor-count, assay-universe, candidate-selection, supplement-traceability, digitization and, in v3, open-window organising-construct fields (marker family, window position, exposure as reported, adult-stratum separability, author window interpretation). v3.1 (PRE-004) appends one optional column, precision_validation.marker_family, at the end of that table; no column is renamed or removed.
metadata.organising_construct: The exercise-induced immune "open window" is an organising construct only: it defines the post-exercise period after an identifiable bout (organising window 0-72 h after cessation, 72 h inclusive), the sampling time points and the marker families to be charted. The review does not test or adjudicate whether an open window exists; original authors' interpretations are charted descriptively (author_window_interpretation) and never affect eligibility or weighting.
metadata.validation_readiness_map_definition: Validation-readiness map: a per-marker, domain-by-domain descriptive profile across the seven precision domains; not a score, ranking, grade or development ladder.
metadata.excel_workbooks: Extraction workbooks are generated from this dictionary and extraction_template.json by scripts/build_workbooks.py; edit the JSON and regenerate, never hand-edit workbook structure. CSV exports are versioned in git.

missing_value_semantics.blank_template_null: Not yet extracted; do not interpret as absent/unreported.
missing_value_semantics.counts: Count fields hold a non-negative integer or a bare missing code (NR, NA, UNCLEAR) only; never prose, ranges, lists or "<=" values. Explanations, alternative denominators and derivations go to the notes field of the same table (cohort_notes, link_notes, sample_notes, measurement_notes, evidence_notes). A count may be derived by arithmetic from numbers printed in the report (e.g. group n summed, or exclusions subtracted) when the derivation is written in notes with the flag DERIVED_N; otherwise UNCLEAR.
missing_value_semantics.identifiers: Primary keys and required linkage keys are assigned stable nonempty IDs, never NR/NA/UNCLEAR. Optional links may be null when inapplicable; unresolved required links remain pending and cannot enter the reconciled dataset.

decision_tree.NA: Not applicable by row type or design (e.g. digitization fields when no value is digitized, donor_count_basis and n_cells for non-cellular assays, candidate_* universe fields on named rows, time_from_exercise_end_value on a resting cross-sectional sample). Prefilled where the rule is deterministic.
decision_tree.NR: Applicable to the row but not reported anywhere in the accessible report, supplements or linked records that were checked.
decision_tree.UNCLEAR: The report contains information but it is conflicting, internally inconsistent or insufficient to choose one value.
decision_tree.order: Ask in this order: (1) does the field apply to this row/design? if not, NA; (2) is it reported? if not, NR; (3) can one value be chosen from the reported information without inference? if not, UNCLEAR.

missing_value_semantics.free_text: Free-text fields that carry a missing code contain the bare code only ("NR", not "NR (not stated)"); the reason goes to the notes field of the same row.
missing_value_semantics.no_inference: Never infer a value from platform conventions (e.g. "Olink is usually plasma"), typical practice, figure icons or axes, the journal section, or the authors' other papers. Adult status follows only the age rule in analysis_unit_rules.population.

reports.description: 一篇出版报告或可区分版本；与cohort经桥表关联。
reports.row_unit: one report or distinguishable version (preprint, accepted manuscript, version of record, correction): one reports row per version. Version rows of one report share the stem of reference_id with a suffix (e.g. R01, R01-V1) and, once the version relationship is verified, are linked through report_cohort_links to the same study_id (study family) and cohort_id; a version stub carries bibliographic and version fields only.

cohorts.description: 一个独立招募来源/参与者集合；同队列跨报告复用cohort_id。
cohorts.row_unit: one recruited participant cohort or separable stratum

report_cohort_links.description: 报告—队列多对多桥接；支持一报告多子研究和一队列多报告。

sample_sets.description: 同一报告/队列/组别 × 基质 × 实际采样时点的样本集合；平台写入 assay_platform（多值）；仅当原文给出不同的平台 n 时按平台拆行。
sample_sets.row_unit: one cohort × group/arm × matrix × time point as sampled in the Methods (whether or not a result is reported for that combination); assay platforms are listed in assay_platform ("; "-separated). Split by platform only when the report gives a platform-specific n that differs between platforms at that time point; split by analysis subgroup only when subgroup n and subgroup results are reported; control-arm time points get their own rows.

measurements.description: 已报告分析物 × 作者报告的统计检验，或组学检测全集汇总行、具名候选行与集合层面结果行；只记录原文结果。
measurements.row_unit: Conventional/targeted assays: one named analyte × one author-reported statistical test (one row for a time main effect across time points; one row per time-point contrast only when each contrast is the reported test). Omics: one assay_universe_summary row per analysis universe (platform × matrix × analysis route) plus one named_immune_candidate row per candidate named in the main text, main tables or figure legends; supplementary result tables are summarised in the universe row by counts and locators; candidates prespecified in the original aims/methods are always enumerated (including nulls); set-level results (pathways, modules, hit counts) as one reported_result_summary row per analysis.

precision_validation.description: 多维precision/validation长表；默认每个 报告 × 队列 × 标志物族 建一组七个域行，仅在原文有分析物特异证据时另建分析物级行；每行仅一个维度，不汇总成总分；evidence_state 为逐标志物 validation-readiness map 的单元格状态（见 metadata.validation_readiness_map_definition）。
precision_validation.row_unit: one report × cohort × marker_family × one domain (default: one set of seven domain rows per report × cohort × marker family, measurement_id null); an additional analyte-level row (measurement_id = one measurement ID) only for a domain where the report gives analyte-specific evidence. No rows for background reports.

extraction_provenance.description: 提取者、独立复核、分歧裁决、AI辅助、数据访问与出版完整性审计。

study_families.description: 独立研究/试验/项目家族；同一试验不同报告共用study_id。

rules: One study_families row may have multiple cohorts.
One report may describe multiple cohorts/studies, and one cohort may produce multiple reports: link through report_cohort_links, never infer independent cohorts from distinct publications alone.

A sample_set is one cohort × group/arm × matrix × time point as sampled; platforms are listed in assay_platform. Split by platform only when a platform-specific n is reported and differs; split by analysis subgroup only when subgroup n and results are reported; each control-arm time point is its own row (PRE-004).
A measurement can be an assay-level tested-universe record or a named-candidate/result record; candidate records share assay_universe_id and link sample_sets.

For assays with large feature spaces, record the tested universe and source/availability in an assay_universe_summary row; enumerate every immune candidate named in the main text, main tables or figure legends, and every candidate prespecified in the original aims/methods wherever its result appears, without a significance filter. Features that appear only in supplementary result tables are summarised in the universe row (counts and locators), not enumerated. Do not fabricate rows for unnamed/unreported features (PRE-004).
A measurement links all sample_sets used in its contrast with sample_set_ids; marker_series_id links the same marker across identified exercise bouts when evaluating Support B.
Participants, donors, biospecimens, cells, aliquots, timepoints and technical replicates are separate counts; none except unique participant/donor n is an independent human biological n.

precision_validation uses exactly seven parent domains with separate subfacets; domains are descriptive and no total score is computed. Domain rows feed the validation-readiness map (metadata.validation_readiness_map_definition): not a score, ranking, grade or development ladder.
All sample, measurement and precision rows must match an existing report-study-cohort tuple in report_cohort_links; cohort.study_id must agree with that tuple.

report_cohort_links.scope_streams records cohort-specific A/B memberships (A_core_acute, B_support_repeated_bouts); one cohort may contribute to both streams and is counted once overall. reports.scope_stream is the multi-valued report-level summary using the same vocabulary (vocabulary_crosswalks.scope_stream).
Primary and required linkage IDs cannot use missing-value codes; null is allowed in blank templates and optional inapplicable links only.

sample_sets.within_organising_window is derived from time_bin through time_bin_rules.window_position; samples later than 72 h after cessation are extracted in full and tagged outside_window_recovery, never excluded (contract 2.2).

Exercise mode, duration and intensity are recorded as reported (exercise_mode, exercise_duration, intensity_metric, intensity_value; dose keeps the verbatim legacy summary); they are evidence-map strata, never eligibility thresholds (contract 2.1).

measurements.marker_family is assigned to every named-candidate and assay-universe row; it groups rows for Figure 1 and the per-marker validation-readiness map (Figure 2) and is not an independent evidence count.

Row IDs are mandatory patterns numbered in order of appearance in the report: measurements M-<ref>-NNN, sample_sets SS-<ref>-NN, precision_validation PV-<ref>-NNN (three/two digits, zero-padded; <ref> = reports.reference_id, e.g. R59); cohort, study and link IDs follow C-<ref>-NN, S-<ref>-NN and L-<ref>-NN. No custom prefixes or analyte codes inside IDs (PRE-004).

precision_validation: default one set of seven domain rows per report × cohort × marker_family (precision_validation.marker_family); analyte-level rows only where analyte-specific domain evidence exists; measurement_id is one measurement ID or null, never a list or the string "NA" (PRE-004).

Background reports (scope_stream = background; screening disposition RETAIN_BACKGROUND) are charted at reduced depth: bibliographic, design, population, assay platforms and n only (reports, study_families, cohorts, report_cohort_links, extraction_provenance; sample_sets one row per cohort × group × matrix with time_bin NA; measurements assay_universe_summary rows describing platforms only, result fields NA); no named-candidate or per-marker result rows and no precision_validation rows; one extractor plus one checker (PRE-004).

Screening and consensus fields in charting workbooks (reports.screening_decision_reviewer_A/B, consensus_screening_decision, primary_fulltext_exclusion_reason) are copied verbatim from the locked screening workbook / merge output and stay null when no screening record exists; extractors and AI tools never enter eligibility opinions in them (PRE-004).

time_bin_rules.ids: controlled_vocabulary.time_bin (single list shared verbatim by extraction_template.json controlled_vocabulary_shared.time_bin and evidence_map_spec.json time_display_only.bins; contract 8.3f)
time_bin_rules.rule: Bins are mutually exclusive display categories derived from the numeric time from cessation; never eligibility thresholds and never a substitute for the exact time. Bins up to and including 24h_to_72h_inclusive are within the organising window; gt72h is outside-window recovery. during is ancillary and not a post-exercise bin. Unknown timing is not imputed to a bin, with the two documented exceptions in boundary_rules (straddling intervals; "immediately after" without a number). ASCII IDs (lt/gt instead of < and >) avoid Excel operator parsing in COUNTIF/filters and CSV/shell quoting problems.
boundary_rules: timepoint_as_reported keeps the source wording verbatim (including any range); time_from_exercise_end_value holds one number only; time_unit is min, h or d.
For a reported interval (e.g. "15-30 min after arrival") the numeric value is the earliest stated bound (15 min).

An interval lying wholly inside one bin takes that bin. An interval that straddles a bin boundary (its upper bound reaches the lower bound of the next bin) takes the LATER bin and sample_notes starts with TIME_BIN_STRADDLE.
Day-level timing (e.g. "two days after the race") is converted to nominal hours (48 h, value 48, unit h, verbatim kept) and flagged DAY_LEVEL_TIMING.
"Immediately/directly after" without any number: time_from_exercise_end_value = NR, time_unit = NA, time_bin = 0_to_lt30min, flag IMMEDIATE_NONNUMERIC (team decision PRE-004).
Periodic training monitoring with an unknown bout-to-sample interval: time_bin = UNCLEAR, sample_role = periodic_training_monitoring; never inferred from figure axes or training schedules.

exercise_end_definition (the timing anchor, e.g. finish line crossing, end of last set) is filled identically on every row of the same bout, including its pre-exercise baseline rows; NA on control-arm and resting rows.

definitions.A_core_acute: Core A: identifiable single bout or competition (any intensity, duration or mode), >=1 post-cessation immune-related sample, and a pre-bout baseline or suitable comparator; adults >= 18 y.
definitions.B_support_repeated_bouts: Support B (retained; cross-bout open-window monitoring layer): same immune-related marker in the same individuals after >=2 identified bouts, explicit bout-to-sample timing and a baseline/suitable comparator; deduplicated against Core A by cohort_id and presented separately.
definitions.background: Original adult human studies with an eligible immune link that are retained for context through the full-text disposition RETAIN_BACKGROUND because their only failure is exposure/timing (habitual-exercise or resting cross-sectional comparisons; periodic, weekly or seasonal monitoring with unknown last-bout timing; training pre/post snapshots with unknown exercise-to-sampling interval). Charted at reduced depth (relational_model.rules); outside every original-study denominator. Reviews used for citation chasing are excluded (FT01), not background. The background register is not a census: RETAIN_BACKGROUND is assigned only at full text.
definitions.excluded: Excluded at title/abstract or full text (one primary FT01-FT08 code at full text).
definitions.uncertain: Eligibility unresolved (awaiting classification/translation or not retrieved); never counted as excluded.
definitions.NA: Not applicable, e.g. a duplicate record or a superseded version (DUPLICATE_RECORD / DUPLICATE_VERSION) whose scope follows the retained record; version stubs use NA, never uncertain.

FRONTIER_PREPRINT: substantive stream as assessed (A_core_acute and/or B_support_repeated_bouts, or uncertain); publication_status = preprint keeps the report in the separate frontier register, never in core totals
ADVANCE: none: title/abstract-only disposition, not a final scope

scope_stream.rule: One controlled vocabulary for dictionary, extraction template, appraisal template, evidence-map spec, protocol text and screening dispositions (contract 8.3g). reports.scope_stream (legacy, report level) and report_cohort_links.scope_streams (cohort level) are multi-valued so INCLUDE_A_AND_B maps to both A and B; overall cohort totals use the union, never the sum. RETAIN_BACKGROUND (v3.1, PRE-004) is an administrative full-text disposition, not a scientific exclusion: it takes no primary FT code (the failed dimension, normally FT04, is kept in secondary_failed_dimensions) and maps to background.

evidence_state.canonical: data_dictionary.json controlled_vocabulary.evidence_state (precision_validation.evidence_state); the validation-readiness map cells use these states.

rows.meaning: The report contains data that address this domain for this marker and support it.
The domain was examined with data and the result was null, not supported or did not replicate.
map_validation_codes: independent_site_or_cohort (validation did not support or replicate)

rows.meaning: The report addresses or proposes the domain but its data do not demonstrate it (co-measured without an association test; proposed use only; internal or same-participant validation only when independent validation is charted).
rows.appraisal_precision_profile_status: EVIDENCE_REPORTED (evidence_note states what was not demonstrated)

rows.meaning: Nothing on this domain is reported in the accessible report; not evidence of absence.
Domain not applicable to this marker/design.
Information is present but cannot be classified after full-text review.

rows.evidence_state: (none: report-level status, not a domain state)
rows.meaning: Report not retrieved or awaiting classification; no precision_validation rows exist.

functional_relation_to_relationship_tags.not_measured: no functional tag; functional_evidence = NR or NA

tested_use_to_dictionary_and_appraisal.proposed_only: validation_use_subtype = no_validation_or_use_test, with reports.author_stated_use or precision_validation.intended_use recorded | PROPOSED_ONLY
tested_use_to_dictionary_and_appraisal.tested_in_independent_cohort_or_prospect: validation_use_subtype = independent_cohort_replication | independent_external_model_validation | prospective_use_or_impact_validation | implementation_or_field_use_validation | TESTED

evidence_state.rule: Appraisal precision_profile_status is a coarser reporting-level code; three extraction states collapse onto EVIDENCE_REPORTED and the appraisal evidence_note must name which. Map validation codes are identical to controlled_vocabulary.validation_split. NR is the only not-reported code.

precision_dimensions.type: seven multidimensional descriptive parent labels with child facets
precision_dimensions.rule: No sum, mean, ranking, readiness score, GRADE synthesis or clinical ranking. Domain evidence is summarised only as the validation-readiness map (see metadata.validation_readiness_map_definition; contract 8.3e).

analysis_unit_rules.n_recruited: People enrolled before any exclusion, for the cohort as defined in the report; alternative enrolment figures are listed in cohort_notes.
analysis_unit_rules.n_analyzed: Unique participants analysed for the primary immune outcome of the report-cohort link; when several denominators exist (different outcomes, platforms or subgroups) record that one and list the others in link_notes; per-time/per-platform n live in sample_sets.
analysis_unit_rules.n_by_assay_time: One sample_sets row per cohort × group/arm × matrix × time point; per-platform n recorded only when the report gives it (then split by platform); keep participant, donor, biological sample, cell, technical repeat and aliquot counts separate.
analysis_unit_rules.single_cell: Record participant n, donor n and cell n separately. donor_count_basis is filled only for single-cell, single-nucleus or sorted-cell assays (NA otherwise): unique_human_donors = distinct people whose cells entered the analysis, counted from the report; unique_participants_equivalent = donor count stated to equal the analysed participant count without per-donor listing; pooled_or_composite_donor_material = cells pooled across people; donor_identity_not_resolved = donor-to-participant relation unclear. n_cells is NA for non-cellular assays. Donor-level pseudobulk/mixed inference cannot be inferred from cell number.
analysis_unit_rules.individual_variation: Record repeated baselines, repeat challenges and within-person variance/measurement error; raw pre-post difference alone does not establish reproducible responder status or personalized utility.
analysis_unit_rules.candidate_universe: Per assay: one assay_universe_summary row with the tested feature universe, counts and source files. Enumerate as named_immune_candidate rows every candidate named in the main text, main tables or figure legends, and every candidate prespecified in the original aims/methods wherever its result appears (including nulls). Features appearing only in supplementary result tables are summarised in the universe row by counts (reported_feature_count, number significant) and locators. Set-level results: one reported_result_summary row per analysis. Never infer unreported nulls.
analysis_unit_rules.figure_values: Figure-only values are NOT digitised (team decision PRE-004): effect_value = NR, effect_value_source = NR, figure_panel_locator = figure and panel, result_direction and result_status from the figure, its legend or the text (significance markers included), digitization_check = NA, other digitization fields NA, measurement_notes starts with FIGURE_ONLY. Any later digitisation requires a further amendment and the predeclared two-reviewer procedure.
analysis_unit_rules.support_B: Support B is retained (contract 2.4) as the cross-bout open-window monitoring layer: require the same marker and same participants across at least two distinct identified exercise-bout IDs, known bout-to-sample timing, and a baseline/comparator; deduplicate against Core A by cohort_id and present separately. It is the main evidence source for the individualization and repeatability domains.
analysis_unit_rules.organising_window: 0-72 h after cessation (72 h inclusive) is the organising window; immediate (0 h) samples are kept; samples later than 72 h are extracted as usual and tagged outside_window_recovery in sample_sets.within_organising_window. No exclusion code or administrative status refers to the window.
analysis_unit_rules.population: Adults >= 18 y (generally healthy people and athletes). Age rule (team decision PRE-004): a cohort, or each separately reported group, counts as adult when an explicit age range or minimum age >= 18 y is reported, OR mean - 2*SD >= 18 y (SD as reported; SEM, IQR or a range of group means do not substitute; flag AGE_RULE_MEAN_2SD). Descriptors such as "adults", "university students" or race entry rules do not establish adult status. If neither condition holds and the report does not state that participants < 18 y were included, the record is AWAITING_CLASSIFICATION at screening (adult_stratum_separable UNCLEAR), not FT03; FT03 applies only when the report states that participants < 18 y were included and no adult stratum with results is separable. Older adults are included and flagged (cohorts.older_adult_subgroup, strictly as defined by the original authors; the review imposes no older-adult cut-off and does not infer older-adult status from mean age). Mixed-age cohorts are eligible only if an adult stratum is separable.
analysis_unit_rules.measurement_rows: Conventional/targeted assays: one row per named analyte × author-reported statistical test. A time main effect (ANOVA/LMM omnibus test) is one row linking all its sample_sets (time-point values summarised in effect_value as reported); separate rows per time-point contrast only when each contrast is the reported test. Subgroup comparisons get rows only when the report gives a separate test. IDs M-<ref>-NNN in order of appearance.
analysis_unit_rules.precision_validation_rows: Default one set of seven domain rows per report × cohort × marker_family (precision_validation.marker_family; measurement_id null); add an analyte-level row (measurement_id = one ID) only for a domain with analyte-specific evidence. No rows for background reports.
analysis_unit_rules.background_reports: Reports with scope_stream background (RETAIN_BACKGROUND): chart bibliographic data, design, population, assay platforms and n only; no per-marker results, no named_immune_candidate or reported_result_summary rows, no precision_validation rows; one extractor and one checker (second-person verification), not two independent extractions.
analysis_unit_rules.version_records: One reports row per version. A related version that was not retrieved, or one superseded by a retrieved peer-reviewed version, gets bibliographic and version fields only, reference_id with a suffix (R01-V1), consensus_screening_decision copied from screening (normally DUPLICATE_VERSION) and scope_stream NA; it is linked to the study family/cohort only after the version relationship is verified. FRONTIER_PREPRINT applies only when no peer-reviewed version exists at the final update.
analysis_unit_rules.author_window_interpretation: Code the authors' own voice: the introduction rationale the authors adopt for this study, the discussion and the conclusions; frameworks merely cited as background are not coded. Multi-valued and exhaustive; one locator per value in author_window_interpretation_locator, written "value: locator". explicit_open_window_term requires the words "open window" (or an explicit equivalent the authors attribute to that concept); redistribution_interpretation only when the authors attribute their own observed change, or absence of change, to cell redistribution, trafficking, mobilisation or homing between compartments; the word "mobilization" alone describing a count increase is not enough. no_window_interpretation when the authors interpret their immune results without any of these; NR when no interpretation of immune results is given.
analysis_unit_rules.screening_fields: Screening and consensus fields are copy-only from the locked screening workbook / merge output, null when no screening record exists; AI tools record eligibility opinions only in pilot or review notes, never in reports.* screening fields.

legacy_mapping_notes.n_by_assay_time: Represent with sample_sets, not a nested assay×time map.
legacy_mapping_notes.exact_times: Preserve source wording plus normalized time from exercise end; time_bin is presentation only.
legacy_mapping_notes.validation: Put each dimension in its own precision_validation row; label co-measurement, association, internal and independent external validation distinctly.
legacy_mapping_notes.provenance: Reviewer/human decisions remain blank until performed.
legacy_mapping_notes.semicolon_targets: Split destination_table and destination_column on semicolons and trim whitespace. Broadcast a single table across multiple columns, or a single column across multiple tables; when both contain multiple targets, pair them positionally. Verify every resulting table.column against the template.

new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.n_donors: Number of unique biological donors contributing to this assay/time sample set; record separately from participants and cells.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.donor_count_basis: Basis used to identify/count biological donors; only for single-cell, single-nucleus or sorted-cell assays, NA otherwise (values defined in analysis_unit_rules.single_cell).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.bout_id / bout_number: Distinct identified exercise event and sequence number; required to test Support B across bouts.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.participant_linkage: Whether the same individuals are documented across repeated event sample sets.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.record_type / assay_univers: record_type (assay_universe_summary / named_immune_candidate / reported_result_summary; definitions in controlled_vocabulary_definitions.measurement_record_type) and assay_universe_id linking named and summary rows to their universe row.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.candidate_selection_rule /: Candidate selection rule, basis and prespecification timing; apply to every non-universe row including conventional targeted assays; prespecification refers to the named candidate, not the platform (controlled_vocabulary_definitions.candidate_fields).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.candidate_in_original_aims_: Audit why each named immune candidate enters the map; include regardless of statistical significance.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.supplement_availability / s: Record whether supplementary candidate/feature lists were available and exact links/locations, including inaccessible files.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.feature_total_count / unit: Record total features or candidates in the reported/testing universe and the file/table/accession where it can be checked.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.result_status: Distinguish explicit null/nonsignificant result from a named candidate whose result was not retrievable or not separately reported; follows the author-reported test and stated threshold (controlled_vocabulary_definitions.result_status).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.marker_series_id: Link the same marker across at least two identified exercise bouts for Support B review (cross-bout open-window monitoring layer).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.effect_value_source and dig: Origin of effect_value. v3.1: figure-only values are not digitised: effect_value_source NR, digitization fields NA, digitization_check NA, figure_panel_locator filled, flag FIGURE_ONLY (analysis_unit_rules.figure_values).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.precision_validation.linkage_subtype: Functional and clinical linkage remain child facets under one parent domain.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.precision_validation.validation_use_subt: Independent validation and use/impact testing remain child facets under one parent domain.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.tested_universe / n / unit: Explicit assay-level tested feature space/denominator: definition plus count and unit, including platform and QC/filtering rules.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.report_cohort_links.scope_streams: Record applicable A_core_acute and/or B_support_repeated_bouts streams for this report-study-cohort relationship (controlled_vocabulary.scope_stream). Both may coexist; deduplicate overall cohort counts. Report-level scope_stream (multi-valued legacy summary) uses the same vocabulary; link-level memberships govern cohort-stratified maps.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.reference_id: Project reference identifier: the record_id of the retained deduplicated screening record, or for pilot items the restart ledger ID (e.g. R59). Version rows of the same report add a suffix (R01-V1, R01-V2). Text; never reused.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.title: Report title exactly as published in the version consulted (bibliographic metadata; single-person entry, second-person verification).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.authors: Author list as published (surname and initials, "; "-separated).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.year: Publication year of the version consulted (text, four digits).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.url: Stable URL of the version consulted (DOI resolver preferred, otherwise PMC/publisher/preprint server URL).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.version_label: Version label and article type as published (e.g. "version of record; short communication", "bioRxiv v2", "Did You Know? (peer reviewed)", correction notice); paired with version_date.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.screening_decision_reviewer_A: Full-text screening disposition of human Reviewer A, copied verbatim from Reviewer A's locked screening workbook / merge output (04_screening/screening_log_template.json field_schema.screening_dispositions, FT stage). A reviewer decision, not Core A membership. Renamed in v3 from screening_A (not legacy-61). Copy-only; null when no screening record exists.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.screening_decision_reviewer_B: Full-text screening disposition of human Reviewer B, copied verbatim from Reviewer B's locked screening workbook / merge output (screening_dispositions, FT stage). A reviewer decision, not Support B membership. Renamed in v3 from screening_B (not legacy-61). Copy-only; null when no screening record exists.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.consensus_screening_decision: Reconciled full-text disposition (screening_log_template full_text.reconciliation.final_disposition): INCLUDE_A, INCLUDE_B, INCLUDE_A_AND_B, EXCLUDE_FT, RETAIN_BACKGROUND or another administrative status; maps to scope_stream through vocabulary_crosswalks.scope_stream.from_screening_disposition. Copy-only; null when no screening record exists.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.primary_fulltext_exclusion_reaso: Canonical v3 field for the single primary full-text exclusion code (first established FT01-FT08 code; 04_screening/fulltext_exclusion_codes.json). Null unless consensus_screening_decision = EXCLUDE_FT; administrative statuses (including RETAIN_BACKGROUND) take no code. Supersedes the legacy column reports.exclusion_reason (deprecated alias, kept null). Copy-only.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.reviewer_notes: Free-text reviewer notes on the report (secondary failed dimensions, boundary reasoning, unresolved questions) with source locators; not a decision field.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.author_stated_use: Use of the marker(s) stated by the original authors, verbatim with locator (e.g. "recovery monitoring"); distinct from precision_validation.intended_use, the use actually evaluated.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.reports.author_window_interpretation / l: Author open-window interpretation (controlled_vocabulary.author_window_interpretation; multi-valued and exhaustive, "; "): authors' own voice only (adopted introduction rationale, discussion, conclusions); one locator per value written "value: locator" (analysis_unit_rules.author_window_interpretation). Charted descriptively under RQ2 (contract 8.3d); never used for eligibility or weighting. no_window_interpretation and NR are not combined with other values.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.cohorts.cohort_label: Short human-readable cohort label (e.g. "recreational half-marathon runners, 2019 race"); not an identifier.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.cohorts.cohort_notes: Free-text notes on the cohort (recruitment source, alternative enrolment figures, overlap reasoning with other reports, separable strata, age-rule derivation) with locators.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.cohorts.age_range: Age range and summary exactly as reported (e.g. "18-35 y; mean 24.1 (SD 3.2)"), including any older-adult threshold used by the authors; NR if not reported (unreported or non-qualifying age remains awaiting classification at screening, not FT03; age rule in analysis_unit_rules.population).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.cohorts.adult_stratum_separable: Adult-population status (controlled_vocabulary.adult_stratum_separable) under the age rule (analysis_unit_rules.population: explicit range/minimum >= 18 y or mean - 2*SD >= 18 y): all participants >= 18 y; mixed-age cohort with a separable adult stratum (eligible; chart that stratum only); mixed-age cohort without a separable adult stratum, or all < 18 y (FT03; only when < 18 y participation is stated); UNCLEAR when the rule cannot be applied.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.cohorts.older_adult_subgroup: Older-adult subgroup flag (controlled_vocabulary.older_adult_subgroup) as defined by the original authors; the review imposes no older-adult age cut-off. Older adults are eligible and presented as a subgroup.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.report_cohort_links.report_specific_popu: Subset of the cohort analysed in this report as described by the report (e.g. "male finishers with complete saliva samples").
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.report_cohort_links.link_notes: Free-text justification of the report-study-cohort link (shared registry ID, identical baseline table, author statement) and the other denominators of this report (outcome-, platform- or subgroup-specific n) with locators.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.group_condition: Group or experimental condition of this sample set as reported (e.g. exercise arm, rest control, placebo + exercise).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.intervention_phase: Training-programme phase in which the bout was performed (e.g. pre-training, post-training, detraining), or single bout only; distinguishes acute challenges before and after training.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.assay_platform: Assay platform(s) applied to this sample set ("; "-separated, e.g. "flow cytometry; Olink Target 96 Inflammation"); the row is split by platform only when the report gives a platform-specific n that differs. Sample-set counterpart of measurements.platform.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.n_aliquots: Number of aliquots analysed for this sample set; a processing count, never an independent biological n.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.age_sex_stratum: Age/sex stratum of this sample set when results are reported by stratum (e.g. women 18-30 y; older adults as defined by the authors); NA when results are not stratified.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.sample_notes: Free-text notes on the sample set (timing-anchor ambiguity, pooling, exclusions; flags TIME_BIN_STRADDLE, DAY_LEVEL_TIMING, IMMEDIATE_NONNUMERIC, DERIVED_N) with locators.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.exercise_duration / intensit: Exercise exposure as reported, never an eligibility threshold (contract 2.1): duration with unit (e.g. "90 min", "42.2 km, 3 h 41 min"); intensity metric exactly as reported, absolute or relative (e.g. %VO2max, %HRmax, %1RM, W, RPE, race pace); intensity value with unit and dispersion as reported. NR when not reported. dose keeps the verbatim legacy summary; exercise_mode stays the legacy mode field.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.sample_sets.within_organising_window: Position of this sample set relative to the 0-72 h organising window (controlled_vocabulary.within_organising_window), derived from time_bin via time_bin_rules.window_position: within_window (0 to 72 h inclusive after cessation), outside_window_recovery (> 72 h; extracted and tagged, never excluded), pre_exercise_baseline, matched_control_time or during_exercise_ancillary.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.effect_measure: Type of effect statistic as reported (e.g. mean difference, fold change, log2FC, % change, ratio, correlation r, AUC).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.effect_value: Point estimate of the effect statistic exactly as reported (text, original precision); its origin is recorded in effect_value_source; NR if not reported. Reviewers never compute or convert values here.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.effect_unit: Unit of effect_value as reported (e.g. cells/uL, pg/mL, % of baseline, log2 units); NA for unitless statistics.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.result_direction: Direction of the reported result for this comparison (controlled_vocabulary.result_direction): increase, decrease, no_detected_difference, mixed_or_inconsistent; describes what the report says, not evidence certainty; non-significance is not recovery.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.reported_feature_count: Number of features for which the report presents results (rows in its results table or supplement), as stated or counted from the source; distinct from tested_universe_n (features tested) and feature_total_count (features in the reported/testing universe).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.measurement_notes: Free-text notes on the measurement row (unit conversions declined, ambiguous labels, cross-references) with locators.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.figure_panel_locator: Figure and panel showing the result (e.g. "Fig. 3B, left"); filled whenever the result is shown only in a figure (FIGURE_ONLY) and whenever a value is digitized; otherwise NA.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.marker_family: Marker family (controlled_vocabulary.marker_family; conventional vs omics classes in vocabulary_crosswalks.marker_family_classes) used to organise Figure 1 and the per-marker validation-readiness map (Figure 2). Named analytes that map to a conventional family are classified by analyte whatever the platform; omics families for universe/summary rows and features without a conventional family (controlled_vocabulary_definitions.marker_family).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.measurements.digitization_check: Status of the second-reviewer check of a digitized value (controlled_vocabulary.digitization_check); NA when effect_value_source is not digitized_from_figure (always NA in v3.1: figure values are not digitised).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.precision_validation.evidence_notes: Free-text statement of the evidence object, sample unit, n, timing, cohort independence and locator supporting evidence_state for this domain row.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.precision_validation.validation_split: How validation participants were separated from development data (controlled_vocabulary.validation_split; identical to evidence_map_spec validation codes): none, resampling of the same participants, participant-level hold-out in the same cohort, independent site or cohort. Only independent_site_or_cohort can support evidence_present for independent validation (vocabulary_crosswalks.evidence_state).
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.extraction_provenance.recorded_at: Date-time (ISO 8601 with time zone) at which the extraction or audit event was recorded.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.extraction_provenance.provenance_notes: Free-text notes on the extraction/audit event (deviations from the manual, access problems, AI-assistance details) with locators.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.study_families.study_label: Short human-readable study/trial label (e.g. acronym or programme name); not an identifier.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.study_families.registry_ids: Trial or study registry identifiers as reported (e.g. NCT, ISRCTN, ChiCTR, DRKS numbers), "; "-separated; NR if none is reported.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.study_families.study_notes: Free-text notes on the study family (linked protocols, sub-studies, programme history) with locators.
new_operational_fields_not_in_legacy_61.precision_validation.marker_family: Marker family (controlled_vocabulary.marker_family) of the domain-row set: one set of seven domain rows per report × cohort × marker family; optional (v3.1, PRE-004), appended as the last column; null on rows created before v3.1.

immune_link_definition: For biofluid omics, an immune objective/candidate must be identifiable in original study aims or methods; preregistration is not required. Post-hoc immune pathway enrichment alone is context, not sufficient main-map immune linkage. Cortisol, creatine kinase, lactate or HRV alone do not satisfy immune linkage; they are charted as covariates in otherwise eligible studies (contract 8.3b). v3.1 (PRE-004): reports.immune_link is multi-valued and exhaustive (every applicable category); whole-blood or PBMC transcriptomes count as immune_cell_omics; deconvolution estimates of cell proportions are not direct_immune_cell_or_count; measurements.omics_integration is coded at the level of the analysis the row reports (single_omics for a single-platform analysis even in a multi-omics study; not_omics for a targeted assay).

note_flags.rule: Flags are upper-case tokens written at the start of the notes field of the affected row (sample_notes, measurement_notes, cohort_notes, link_notes, reviewer_notes), separated by "; ", followed by the explanation. They are audit markers, not new columns or vocabulary values.
note_flags.TIME_BIN_STRADDLE: sample_sets: a reported time interval crosses a time-bin boundary; binned to the later bin (time_bin_rules.boundary_rules).
note_flags.DAY_LEVEL_TIMING: sample_sets: timing reported in days only (e.g. "two days after"); converted to nominal hours (1 d = 24 h) for binning.
note_flags.IMMEDIATE_NONNUMERIC: sample_sets: "immediately/directly after" with no number; time_from_exercise_end_value = NR, time_bin = 0_to_lt30min.
note_flags.DERIVED_N: any count derived arithmetically from numbers printed in the report; the derivation is written after the flag.
note_flags.FIGURE_ONLY: measurements: the result is shown only in a figure; direction and significance recorded from the figure/legend/text, no value digitized (analysis_unit_rules.figure_values).
note_flags.AGE_RULE_MEAN_2SD: cohorts: adult status established by mean - 2*SD >= 18 y (analysis_unit_rules.population).
note_flags.ACCEPTED_DATE_USED: reports: version_date is the accepted date because neither online nor issue date is printed.

controlled_vocabulary_definitions.note: Definitions of v3.1 (PRE-004) vocabulary values and of values whose meaning was ambiguous in the charting pilot. Legacy free-text fields matrix, exercise_mode, training_status, design and time_unit now use these lists (legacy field names and data types unchanged; workbook dropdowns are warning-style for these legacy fields, but values outside the list are protocol deviations to be explained in notes).

measurement_record_type.assay_universe_summary: One row per analysis universe (platform × matrix × analysis route, e.g. per-cluster vs whole-sample pseudobulk). Carries tested_universe*, feature_total_*, reported_feature_count, feature_universe_locator, supplement_*; candidate_* fields NA; result fields summarise the analysis (e.g. number of significant features) or NA.
measurement_record_type.named_immune_candidate: One single named analyte/feature (gene, protein, metabolite, cell subset, cytokine, count), from any assay type including conventional targeted assays, × one author-reported test.
measurement_record_type.reported_result_summary: One set-level result that is not attributable to a single analyte: pathway/GSEA/module score, cell-type deconvolution summary, number of hits; members named by the authors are listed in analyte_id.original_label.

controlled_vocabulary_definitions.candidate_fields: candidate_selection_rule, candidate_selection_basis, candidate_prespecification_status, candidate_in_original_aims_methods and candidate_source_locator apply to every named_immune_candidate and reported_result_summary row, including conventional targeted assays (e.g. a haematology analyser panel: complete_targeted_panel / original_methods); they are NA on assay_universe_summary rows. Prespecification refers to the named candidate itself, not to the platform: an untargeted platform named in the methods does not make its hits prespecified.

candidate_selection_rule.all_named_immune_candidates_from_origina: The candidate is named in the original aims/methods as an immune target and is charted whatever its result.
candidate_selection_rule.complete_targeted_panel: The candidate is one analyte of a targeted assay/panel whose full analyte list is reported (e.g. differential blood count, cytokine multiplex).
candidate_selection_rule.statistically_selected_hits_from_untarge: The candidate is named because it passed the authors' statistical threshold in an untargeted screen (differential expression, feature selection).
candidate_selection_rule.author_reported_feature_set: The candidate belongs to a feature set the authors report for another stated reason (e.g. top-ranked, curated list) without a statistical selection rule.
candidate_selection_rule.other_source_defined_rule: Any other rule stated by the source; describe in measurement_notes.

candidate_selection_basis.original_methods: Named in the methods (assay list, panel, prespecified outcome).
candidate_selection_basis.registered_protocol_or_analysis_plan: Named in a registered protocol or analysis plan.
candidate_selection_basis.results_statistical_selection: First appears in the results as a statistically selected hit.
candidate_selection_basis.supplement: Named only in supplementary material that defines the candidate list.

controlled_vocabulary_definitions.result_status: Follows the author-reported test and the authors' stated significance threshold (e.g. p = 0.056 against alpha 0.05 is explicitly_reported_non_significant_or_null even if the authors list the analyte in a table of discriminating features); without a stated threshold use the authors' own wording; if neither, UNCLEAR.

sample_role.nonexercise_control: Sample from a non-exercise condition or arm within the same study and cohort (rest arm, rest day of a crossover); every time point of that arm, including samples concurrent with the exercise arm, uses time_bin matched_control_time.
sample_role.matched_control: Sample from separately recruited matched control participants (a different cohort or group that never performs the bout).
sample_role.periodic_training_monitoring: Scheduled sample during a training programme or season with unknown bout-to-sample interval; time_bin UNCLEAR unless the interval is stated (never inferred from figure axes or schedules).
sample_role.resting_habitual_group: Resting sample of a habitual-activity or training-status group in a cross-sectional comparison (background reports); time_bin NA.

marker_family.assignment_rule: A named analyte that maps to a conventional family is classified by the analyte, whatever the platform (IL-6 measured by Olink = cytokine_or_inflammatory_mediator; lactoferrin by ELISA = mucosal_antimicrobial_protein). Omics families are used for assay_universe_summary rows, reported_result_summary rows and omics features without a conventional family. Platelet/megakaryocyte or stress-response genes (e.g. PF4, PPBP, HSP90AA1) are other with a note. Saliva flow rate and similar normalisation covariates are recorded in sample_sets.normalization, not as measurement rows, unless the report analyses them as an outcome.
marker_family.mucosal_antimicrobial_protein: Mucosal/salivary antimicrobial proteins and peptides other than secretory IgA (e.g. lactoferrin, lysozyme, alpha-defensins/HNP1-3, LL-37/cathelicidin, salivary alpha-amylase only when analysed as an antimicrobial/immune outcome); conventional class.

controlled_vocabulary_definitions.matrix: Single value per sample_sets row: whole_blood (including capillary/dried blood spot, with note); PBMC; sorted_or_isolated_immune_cells (e.g. CD4+ T cells, neutrophils); plasma; serum; saliva; urine; sweat; extracellular_vesicles (isolated EVs from any fluid; source fluid in notes); other_cell_free_biofluid (cfDNA/cfRNA preparations, nasal lavage, tears); tissue; other. Not inferred from platform conventions.
controlled_vocabulary_definitions.exercise_mode: Physiological mode of the identified bout: endurance; resistance; interval_or_sprint; mixed_or_concurrent; intermittent_team_or_racket_sport; other. Competitions are coded by their mode (a marathon race is endurance); the competition setting is kept verbatim in dose. Not inferred from figure icons.
controlled_vocabulary_definitions.training_status: As labelled by the authors (untrained_or_sedentary, recreationally_active, trained, elite_or_professional); mixed_training_status when the cohort combines statuses; no inference from performance values.
controlled_vocabulary_definitions.design: Study design as reported and checked against the methods: randomized_parallel; randomized_crossover; nonrandomized_controlled; nonrandomized_crossover; single_group_pre_post; prospective_cohort; cross_sectional; case_series_or_case_report; other.
controlled_vocabulary_definitions.time_unit: min, h or d only, paired with a numeric time_from_exercise_end_value.
controlled_vocabulary_definitions.publication_status: Describes peer-review and version status only. Short formats (short communication, research letter, brief report, "Did You Know?", concept paper, rapid communication) that report original data are coded by their review status (normally peer_reviewed_version_of_record or peer_reviewed_online_first) and the article type is written in version_label; check that the section is peer reviewed (journal policy for that article type), otherwise UNCLEAR. editorial_or_commentary only for items without original data.
